profile.name: FEI4命令序列控制器
profile.description: 这是一种用于FEI4前端像素读出电子学的FPGA命令序列模块，可存储并输出数字命令序列，并支持重复输出、起始/停止序列长度、输出使能、外部触发和时钟门控等设置。它常用于粒子探测器前端芯片的读出、联调与实验室测试。
profile.description_en: This is an FPGA-based command sequencer module for FE-I4 front-end pixel readout electronics. It stores and outputs digital command sequences and supports settings such as repetition, start/stop sequence length, output enable, external triggering, and clock gating. It is typically used for readout, integration, and laboratory testing of particle-detector front-end chips.
